body:
# Border Run

A lightweight modpack designed specifically for the Border Run challenge — a journey where the only goal is to keep moving toward the world border.

This pack stays close to vanilla Minecraft while adding carefully selected quality-of-life improvements that make long-distance travel, exploration and survival more enjoyable. The focus is on performance, stability and reducing unnecessary frustration during extended play sessions.

## Features

* Improved game performance and optimization
* Faster world loading and smoother exploration
* Quality-of-life enhancements for travel and inventory management
* Gravestones to help recover items after death
* Better transportation options, including horses in boats
* Zoom functionality for scouting distant terrain
* Optional cosmetic additions such as Immersive Armors
* Various small tweaks that improve the overall gameplay experience without changing the core vanilla progression

## Included Mods

Some examples of included mods:

* Carry On
* Fast Paths
* Gravestones
* HorseInBoat
* Immersive Armors
* Just Zoom
* Matowo's Invisible Armor

## Why Border Run?

Border Run is all about the adventure of crossing vast distances, discovering new terrain and surviving whatever the world generates in front of you. This modpack removes common annoyances, improves performance and provides useful tools while preserving the classic Minecraft experience.

No tech mods. No magic mods. No altered progression.

Just you, the world, and the long road to the border.
